_about: Release check registry for scripts/check-release.mjs. Values are SHA-256 fingerprints (first 16 hex characters) of RevenueCat PUBLIC SDK keys, never the keys themselves. Set confirmed:true only after reading the key in the RevenueCat dashboard (Rapid Nursing Review project). 'otherApps' = keys of other apps' projects, which must never ship here.

ios.source: fingerprint of the key committed in mobile/app.json
ios.note: Recorded so a changed key is caught. NOT evidence of which RevenueCat project it belongs to (Rico reported a separate 'Rapid Nursing Review Android' project that holds CCRN identifiers).

evidence.report: 2026-10-29: Rico's written report lists entitlements and product IDs for this app but no key fingerprints.
